### GET `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/members`

**List the members of an organization**

Paged with the canonical envelope `{ data, has_more, next_offset }` - BREAKING: `total`, `limit` and `offset` were removed. Read `has_more`; `next_offset` is null - never absent, never 0 - on the last page.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

### POST `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/members`

**Invite someone to the organization**

Always 202, whether the address is already a member, already has an account, or is unknown - anything else would let a member enumerate the platform. No membership is created here: the invitee redeems a single-use token from their own mailbox at POST /v1/invitations/accept. 403 if the requested role is above the caller's own rank.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgId` | path | string | yes |  | Organization id, `org_…`. |

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [InviteMemberDto](./schemas.md#invitememberdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | max 320 chars |  |
| `role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` | Must be a role the caller may assign: never above their own rank. An admin cannot invite an owner. |

#### Responses

**202 Accepted** - [InvitationAcceptedDto](./schemas.md#invitationaccepteddto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | yes |  | Deliberately uninformative. The response is identical whether the address is already a member, has an account, or has none - anything else would let a member enumerate the platform. |

**403 Forbidden** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)

The caller may not assign that role.

`error.code`: [`forbidden`](./errors.md#forbidden), [`email_not_verified`](./errors.md#email-not-verified)

### PATCH `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/members/{memberId}`

**Change a member's role**

Enforced by the role lattice: never your own membership, never a role above your own rank, never a member who outranks you, and never the last owner. The owner count is taken inside the same transaction as the write.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgId` | path | string | yes |  | Organization id, `org_…`. |
| `memberId` | path | string | yes |  | Membership id, `mem_…`. |

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [UpdateMemberRoleDto](./schemas.md#updatememberroledto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` | Enforced by the role lattice: never your own membership, never a role above your own rank, never someone who outranks you, and never the last owner. |

#### Responses

**200 OK** - [MemberDto](./schemas.md#memberdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `user_id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `email` | string \| null | yes |  |  |
| `name` | string \| null | yes |  |  |
| `role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` |  |
| `disabled` | boolean | yes |  | True when the account has been disabled platform-wide. |
| `created_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |

**403 Forbidden** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)

The lattice refused the change.

`error.code`: [`forbidden`](./errors.md#forbidden), [`email_not_verified`](./errors.md#email-not-verified)

**409 Conflict** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)

The change would leave the organization with no owner.

`error.code`: [`conflict`](./errors.md#conflict), [`limit_exceeded`](./errors.md#limit-exceeded), [`idempotency_key_reused`](./errors.md#idempotency-key-reused)

### POST `/v1/invitations/accept`

**Redeem a membership invitation**

Requires a session: the token proves possession of a mailbox, the session proves who is asking, and the two must be the same address. Single-use, and refused if the inviting member no longer holds the rank to grant that role. Redeeming an invitation you have already accepted returns the organization unchanged rather than altering your role.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [AcceptInvitationDto](./schemas.md#acceptinvitationdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | string | yes | 20 to 200 chars | The single-use token from the invitation email. |

#### Responses

**200 OK** - [AcceptedInvitationDto](./schemas.md#acceptedinvitationdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `organization` | [OrganizationDto](./schemas.md#organizationdto) | yes |  | The organization the caller has just joined, with their new role. |
| `organization.id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `organization.name` | string | yes | max 200 chars |  |
| `organization.slug` | string | yes |  | Globally unique, URL-safe. |
| `organization.status` | string | yes | one of `active`, `suspended`, `deleted` |  |
| `organization.role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` | The requesting user's role in this organization. |
| `organization.created_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |
| `organization.updated_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |

**400 Bad Request** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)
